note: Single source of truth for the category taxonomy. Nodes carry id, display name, emoji, optional children, and aliases (legacy category strings mapped to this node at runtime). Consumed by the site runtime (src/scripts/shared/data-loader.ts), the build (scripts/config/categories.js), and validation (scripts/validate-categories.js). Libraries are a separate axis and are NOT in this tree.
